resources.string: Choose when your phone reminds you to measure. These reminders do not change alarms on your monitor.
Skip if measured in the previous minutes

Skip this occurrence if a measurement from any user was recorded within this many minutes before its scheduled time. The default is 120 minutes (2 hours). Set 0 to always remind. Importing older history does not count as a recent measurement.
Delete this reminder? Saved measurements will remain.
Enter 0 or a positive whole number of minutes.
Could not save the reminder. Try again.
Allow alarms and reminders for precise timing. Without this access, Android may deliver reminders late. Reopen OpenPressure if you revoke access in system settings.
Reminder notifications are turned off. Enable them in Android settings to receive reminders.
Reminders at the measurement times you choose.
Take a blood pressure measurement when convenient.
